compiled_state.title: Add dso_reconciler.__main__ entry module that runs one steady-state pass and exits 0 on converged state
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description: RED task. Create plugins/dso/scripts/dso_reconciler/__main__.py — the Python module entry point invoked by the GHA workflow as 'python -m dso_reconciler'. Orchestrates one steady-state pass calling fetcher.py / differ.py / applier.py / mapping.py / manifest.py / health.py modules in sequence. Exits 0 on converged state, non-zero on unrecoverable error. Unit test uses subprocess or runpy to assert process exit code 0 on converged stub path.
